title: Global Uniqueness for the Smooth Isotropic Elasticity Inverse Problem

abstractEnglish: We prove that the full static displacement-to-traction map uniquely determines both real smooth Lamé moduli on every bounded connected smooth domain in ℝ3, provided μ > 0 and $`3\lambda+2\mu\gt 0`$ on the closure. This resolves the smooth three-dimensional isotropic elastic Calderón uniqueness problem under these positivity assumptions.
